jobs_results.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™




JOB DESCRIPTION


ASRC Federal is looking for an experienced Data Architect – Senior to support their work with the U.S. Army Contracting Command (ACC) Chief Information Officer (CIO) at Redstone Arsenal, AL. The Data Architect will lead enterprise-scale data initiatives by collecting, engineering, and modeling data from multiple disparate sources to deliver actionable insights and support strategic decision-making across ACC.


This role involves the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable data architectures, predictive modeling, data normalization, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. The Data Architect will also be responsible for creating intelligent solutions that align with organizational goals, KPIs, and secure data governance standards, as well as supporting workforce training and continuous data literacy development.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Collect, analyze, clean, normalize, and model large datasets from varied sources
Develop, test, and implement predictive models, AI/ML algorithms, and advanced statistical analyses
Design and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, data lakes, and data warehouses
Create enterprise strategies and data-driven solutions to support ACC operations and mission success
Design and enforce data governance, quality, and security standards including data labeling
Present data-driven results clearly and effectively to leadership and stakeholders
Develop and report metrics aligned to Government-defined KPIs
Design and build APIs to access data and systems
Facilitate and manage data storage, cataloging, and retrieval for accessible knowledge sharing
Promote cross-team collaboration through data transparency, tools, and structured documentation
Lead lessons-learned initiatives, apply industry best practices, and support process improvement
Conduct Command-wide training and awareness initiatives to promote data literacy and secure usage
Participate in workshops, seminars, and conferences to support enterprise data advancement

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Minimum of 5 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or analytics
Experience in one or more of the following:

Enterprise data architecture and governance
Building data pipelines and ETL processes
Data modeling and predictive analytics
Statistical tools, programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL)
Cloud-based and on-premises data platforms

Familiarity with designing and building APIs
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences
Demonstrated ability to lead strategic data initiatives and support training across large organizations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Master’s degree in a data-related field
Experience with AI/ML platforms, data visualization tools, and DoD data environments
Familiarity with data cataloging tools and metadata management systems
Certifications in data engineering, architecture, or analytics (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer, CDMP)
Experience implementing data classification and security frameworks in government environments

 


CLEARANCE LEVEL



SECRET Clearance

EDUCATION REQUIRMENTS



Bachelor’s degree in a related field

CERTIFICATION



N/A

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:



This role is 100% on-site at Redstone Arsenal, AL.

We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); education assistance; paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. The salary offered will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity, business needs, and other factors permitted by law. Posted pay ranges are a general guideline only and are not a guarantee of compensation or salary.

jobs_results.title: Lead Data Architect
jobs_results.description:
Analytica is looking for a Lead Data Architect to oversee, manage and provide hands-on implementation of enterprise data architecture, DataOps and MLOps for key client program centered around network and entity services. This leader designs and sustains data architectures and data pipelines that support identity and biometrics applications, integrates law-enforcement-sensitive data for screening and vetting, and leads for AI/ML practice spanning model development, deployment, and continuous validation on AWS and Databricks. 

Analytica has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing 250 businesses in the US for 3 years. We work with U.S. government clients in health, civilian, and national security missions to build better technology products that impact our day-to-day lives. The company offers competitive compensation with opportunities for bonuses, employer-paid health care, training and development funds, and 401k match.   

Key Responsibilities:  

Lead and architect enterprise-wide initiatives including system integration, data migration, transformation, data warehouse build, data mart build, data lakes implementation and support, and O&M for a large enterprise. 

Develop and evaluate production AI/ML solutions in AWS and Databricks. 

Apply advanced proficiency in statistical, programming, and engineering methods for data analysis (e.g., SQL, Python, statistical modeling). 

Lead Relational and Dimensional Data Modeling across identity and biometrics data domains. 

Establish and enforce a data governance framework to improve accuracy using integrated internal and external disparate data sources. 

Conduct cost-benefit analyses for competing technical and architectural options. 

Integrate AI/ML, data analytics, and entity resolution into DevSecOps workflows and system architectures. 

Maintain AI/ML models through user stories and the DevSecOps CI/CD pipeline, including optimization and evaluation of alternates. 

Prefer open-source models; provide comparable analysis and justification when proprietary models are proposed. 

Provide a continuous model validation framework to the extent possible. 

Support data analytics on program and system activities, including assessment of performance and manual processes with automation/optimization recommendations. 

Mentor Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Database Management staff; collaborate with Architect Leads and ISSO personnel on secure handling of law-enforcement-sensitive data. 





Required Experience & Qualifications: 

US Citizen with the ability to secure a US public trust clearance 

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field  

10+ years of IT experience, focusing on enterprise data architecture, AI/ML, data engineering, and data management. 

5+ years of experience implementing AWS and/or Databricks data solutions 

Significant experience with Python and Python 

Proven Experience leading and architecting enterprise-wide initiatives spanning system integration, data migration, transformation, data warehouse/mart build, data lakes implementation and support, and O&M for a large enterprise. 

Proven expertise in Relational and Dimensional Data Modeling and Lakehouse architectures 

Advanced proficiency in statistical, programming, and/or engineering in building DataOPs and MLOPs pipelines for data analysis 



Preferred Experience & Qualifications: 

Databricks Professional or AWS Solution Architect or Data Engineer strongly preferred 

Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related quantitative discipline. 

Experience with PyTorch, SciKit-Learn, NumPy, Spark/Scala, Kafka, and PostgreSQL. 

Experience with Tableau and large-scale data visualization for executive and operational reporting. 

Prior USCIS, DHS, or federal law enforcement / national security data program experience.

Magazine as one of the 250 fastest-growing companies in the U.S. and as a Great Place to Work for 3 sequential years. jobs_results.description:
Job Title: Data Solutions Architect - Fabric Modernization


Location: Houston, TX / Chicago, IL
Duration: Contract


Overview:


We are seeking a strategic Data Architect with deep expertise in Microsoft Fabric to lead and unify our data modernization initiatives. In this role, you will act as an architectural integrator, bridging the gap between business requirements and technical execution across multiple data teams. You will not be expected to be a hands-on software developer writing production code; rather, your focus will be on providing cross-team leadership, architectural governance, and strategic oversight to ensure cohesion as we modernize and rationalize our existing data platforms.


Key Responsibilities:



 Architectural Integration & Governance: Provide overarching leadership and architectural direction to connect disparate data modernization components and teams, ensuring consistency and cross-team alignment.
 Fabric-Centric Design: Lead the design and implementation strategies utilizing Microsoft Fabric (including OneLake and modern data movement patterns), which will comprise approximately 50% of the role's focus.
 Platform Modernization: Focus on rationalizing current architecture and migrating/standardizing data flows, rather than purely greenfield, net-new design.
 Deliverable Creation: Produce critical architectural documentation, including Architecture Review Artifacts (current/target states, technology recommendations) and Low-Level Solution Designs (detailed diagrams and component-level designs).
 Troubleshooting & Guidance: Provide high-level troubleshooting and technical guidance to execution teams without getting bogged down in building the production solutions yourself.

Required Qualifications & Profile:



 Core Technology: Extensive, hands-on architectural experience with Microsoft Fabric (mandatory).
 Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical execution teams.
 Experience Level: Strong background in data modernization, migration, and standardizing existing architectures.
 Technical Knowledge: Foundational understanding of SQL and scripting (sufficient for troubleshooting and architectural oversight, not production development). Expert-level Azure knowledge is highly beneficial, though not strictly required.

This is a strategic oversight and architecture role. We need someone with hands on Microsoft Fabric architecture experience


Pay: From $85.00 per hour

jobs_results.description:
Standard Job Description 

Join Lockheed Martin's Data and AI Enablement organization and accelerate the company's AI transformation. As the manager of the Enterprise Data Product Team's architects and engineers, you will play a key role in leading the build of the corporation's data foundation to enable use of AI agents at scale. You will develop strategy for the team's operations, manage customer relationships, bring key stakeholders on the AI transformation journey, lead the creation and deployment of critical data products, support the build and operationalization of our enterprise ontology, oversee the team's engineering operations and manage and grow our organization's talent. If you have a passion for making business impact through cutting-edge technology, this role is for you. 

Key Responsibilities 
 Work with functional partners to create enterprise data products that provide maximal value to the corporation. Build relationships with key stakeholders to ensure their support for the team's mission. Ensure data product alignment with enterprise ontology standards and guardrails. Work with functional partners to produce validation tests for enterprise ontologies. Develop strategies to enable team to overcome obstacles in building the corporation's data foundations. Optimize team operations to maximize quality and efficiency. Optimize the work experience of our team's architects and engineers, and enable them to grow their careers in the directions they wish. Identify and hire new talent for the team. Basic QualificationsBachelor's (or higher) in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Management, or a related field. 8 + years of experience working in data engineering/analysis/science, with at least 2 years of experience working in management. 3 + years of experience delivering concrete business value through technical ownership of portions of an enterprise data platforms. Proven ability to influence stakeholders and motivate action through superior communication and relationship building skills Demonstrated ability to apply strategic thinking to solve programmatic issues. Demonstrated ability to deliver business value through optimizing engineering operations and plans. Desired SkillsExperience productizing data sets for enterprise consumption. Experience operationalizing ontologies, taxonomies, or knowledge graphs that enable AI agent operations. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops. Experience with use case-driven software development. Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork and internal-customer support. Master's degree or advanced technical training. Experience with Databricks and/or medallion data architectures. Experience implementing data access controls in complex systems. Hands-on experience using genAI to solve business problems. Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow-both professionally and personally.

Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

jobs_results.title: Data Architect (100% Remote) (EMEA Only)
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: EMEA

 

About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

Role Overview

As a Data Architect, you will lead or support the development of advanced, secure data solutions for innovative digital marketing platforms. You'll craft data strategy, architecture, SQL, and governance for customer solutions spanning end-to-end profiles, segmentation, journeys, and campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

•     Provide deep experience building data solutions across multiple Adobe products and cloud platforms aligned with enterprise data strategy

•     Engage closely with customers to facilitate data discovery, evaluating systems and business processes, and analyzing sources, movement, granularity, and format

•     Unify disparate data (sales, CRM, analytics, etc.) to meet digital marketing use cases; lead development of conceptual, logical, and physical data models

•     Define standards for data quality, master data management, data governance, modeling, tooling, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance (PII, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR)

•     Engage cross-disciplinary groups to identify customer demands and provide scalable, secure data blueprints

•     Provide solutions for growing data volumes, tools, and integrations aligned with customer objectives

•     Deliver data lake and real-time customer profile readiness for ingestion/activation, using REST APIs, Postman, and scripting to automate setup

•     Develop data ingestion solutions for streaming and batch processing; collaborate on ETL/ELT pipelines

•     Improve data query performance across platforms while ensuring product guardrails are followed

•     Drive end-to-end data migration initiatives, maintaining data quality, integrity, and compliance
